seo.title: Open in HubGet – HubGet
seo.description: Open an app in HubGet – the free, open-source app store for Windows. You always confirm the installation.

texty.t2: This link opens the app in HubGet – an app store for Windows. Nothing installs on its own: you confirm the installation in HubGet.
texty.t5: Don’t have HubGet? Download it for free, install it and click Open in HubGet again.
texty.t7: Is your app in WinGet? Add a badge to your README or website that opens it in HubGet. Copy the badge code in HubGet: app details → Share → Badge for README.
